name: Recurrent Drafter for Fast Speculative Decoding in Large Language Models
notes: ReDrafter uses RNN as draft model conditioning on LLM hidden states, with dynamic tree attention over beam search results. Up to 2.8x speedup on Vicuna MT-Bench with PyTorch on H100 GPUs. Also validated on Apple Silicon (MLX/Metal) with up to 2.3x speedup. Trained via knowledge distillation from the LLM.
